title: Hierarchical CMN configuration and mesh editing
summary: Translated complex coherent-mesh hardware hierarchy into interactive configuration and visualization workflows.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2022-06-14. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Built CMN mesh configuration and visualization workflows for crosspoints, devices, CAL representations, domains, instance inspection and device groups.
Implemented group creation, deletion, renaming and parameterization, group-member port assignments, internal interfaces, MCS editing, tile-definition and combined-mesh views.
Coordinated Angular components, TypeScript services, Configuration Engine metadata, validation and tests to keep hierarchical hardware editing consistent.
Evolved CMN GUI tooling from API-backed mesh and device inspection into editable groups, port assignments, tile definitions and combined-mesh views.
Integrated tile service APIs, tile editor/viewer components and navigation with mesh visualization to support tile-definition and combined-mesh workflows.
Implemented multiport and super-device group-member configuration, preserving distinctions between logical devices, physical ports and group assignments.
Drove user-defined-group regression inputs from live engine metadata and hardened duplicate-name handling in group creation.

notes: June 2022 is the inspected node-configuration scaffold milestone, not delivery of the complete editor. API-backed rendering followed in December 2022; editing, tiles and multiport workflows were added later.

2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
